name: cross-margin-fail
description: Same setup as `cross-margin-survival` but with a much deeper crash: ETH drops from $100 to $50 (a 50% move). At this point even Alice's perp position's unrealized PnL is not enough to absorb the lending health hit. Unified margin breaks alongside siloed margin; the liquidation engine fires and the position is unwound. This is the negative control: it proves cross-margin doesn't make the system invulnerable, only better at netting risks within bounds.
headline: A 50% ETH crash overwhelms even cross-margin; the liquidation engine fires.

steps.explanation: Same lending-demo flow, deeper crash. The CLI output should show unified margin moving to LIQUIDATABLE (or Underwater) instead of HEALTHY.
